multi4.title: Monorepo Dependency Fix
multi4.verification_method: static-analysis (AST-level dependency-graph tracing, version-constraint resolution, and per-assertion test-logic tracing; no command execution per verifier permission boundary). Cross-checked with executor3's reported pytest result (7 passed).

requirements.requirement: Break circular dependency (models must not import from api)
requirements.evidence: models/helpers.py imports `from utils.formatters import format_response` (canonical), no `api.` import. utils/formatters.py defines format_response(). api/formatters.py re-exports from utils.formatters and keeps format_error(). Dependency graph acyclic.

requirements.requirement: Update stale version pin (utils must require core>=1.2)
requirements.evidence: utils/setup.cfg install_requires is now `core>=1.2` (was core==1.0). grep found no remaining `core==1.0` / `==1.0`.

requirements.requirement: Fix moved function import (worker must import process_item from utils)
requirements.evidence: worker/tasks.py imports `from utils.processing import process_item`. utils/processing.py defines it; core/processing.py no longer defines it. grep found no remaining `from core.processing` import.

requirements.requirement: No package has a circular dependency
requirements.evidence: AST import-graph: core={}, utils={core}, models={core,utils}, worker={core,utils}, api={core,models,utils}. DFS finds no cycle.
core=1.2.0; models(core>=1.0), api(core>=1.0,models>=1.0), worker(core>=1.0), utils(core>=1.2) all satisfied at core 1.2.0.

requirements.requirement: All tests in tests/ must pass
requirements.evidence: Static trace of all 7 assertions passes (no api.* import in models/helpers.py; models.helpers imports cleanly exposing serialize_entity+format_response; acyclic graph; process_item ImportFrom == utils.processing; run_batch returns 1 item with processed=True; utils core dep single with >= and no ==1.0; all >= constraints met). executor3 reported pytest tests/ = 7 passed.

multi4.notes: No residual stale references found (grep for api.formatters import, core.processing import, and ==1.0 pin all returned empty).

spec5.title: SPEC5: Worker Service Configuration System
spec5.summary: config_system.py fully conforms to Subtask 2 of spec.md. All 11 schema keys, type coercion rules, priority cascade, error handling, and API contract verified against the authoritative specification (not the partial config_schema.json).

checks.detail: All 11 keys present with correct type, default, env var, and validation bounds: queue_url(string,non-empty), concurrency(int,1-32), max_retries(int,0-20), retry_backoff_seconds(int,1-300), job_timeout(int,1-3600), log_level(enum DEBUG/INFO/WARN), dead_letter_queue(bool), heartbeat_interval(int,5-300), prefetch_count(int,1-100), ack_on_failure(bool), metrics_enabled(bool). Schema defined once at module level (_SCHEMA), not duplicated.

int: parses int strings via int(); raises ConfigValidationError on non-parseable strings; rejects bool (subclass guard) and rejects float without silent truncation; range checked inclusive via min/max.
float branch present (parses float, rejects bool, rejects non-numeric) as required by the coercion spec; no schema key currently uses float so it is inert but compliant.
bool accepts true/false (case-insensitive), 1/0, yes/no, on/off string inputs; also accepts native bool and int 0/1; strips whitespace; raises ConfigValidationError for any other string.
enum validates coerced string against allowed values; case-sensitive (log_level rejects 'info'); non-string rejected.

Order is cli_args > env_vars > config_file > defaults. Layers applied low-to-high (defaults -> file -> env -> cli), so higher priority overrides lower. A key is 'provided' only when key present AND value is not None; empty string '' counts as provided and is still overridden by a non-None higher-priority value.
All 11 CELERY_* env var names map to the correct config keys. env_vars=None defaults to os.environ.

JSON object with config keys as fields; unknown keys ignored (k in schema filter); non-dict JSON safely ignored; missing file raises FileNotFoundError via open(); JSON syntax errors propagate naturally.
ConfigValidationError subclasses ValueError. Every validation error message includes key name and invalid value (format: "Config key '{key}' has invalid value {value!r}: <reason>").

load_config(config_file=None, env_vars=None, cli_args=None), get_schema(), validate_value(key, value) signatures match spec. get_schema() returns a deep copy (caller mutation cannot corrupt internal schema). load_config returns all 11 keys populated with defaults when no source provides a value.
